description_excerpt: Job Description WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON What you will focus on Great games start with great design. As a Game Designer at Gameloft Saigon, you'll shape the mechanics, systems and levels that keep players coming back. You'll turn ideas into playable features, test them fast and refine them with artists, programmers and producers. What it means on a daily basis • Design gameplay mechanics, levels, combat and systems that are intuitive and fun. • Write and maintain clear design documents covering mechanics, features, flow and UI. • Prototype ideas and iterate using feedback from the team…
